# ADR-3088: A08: Untrusted plugin import for extension host 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Plugins run with host privileges.

## Decision

Hosts MUST NOT load an untrusted plugin import for extension host 4 (A08-4).

## Consequences

Plugins are signed and permission-scoped.
